description: Contains Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes for creating, updating, and returning recipe information in the RecipeBackend project. Defines schemas for recipe creation, updates, and retrieval, including validation attributes and data fields.

classes.name: CreateRecipeDto
classes.description: DTO for creating a new recipe with validation attributes for Title, Ingredients, and Instructions.

classes.name: UpdateRecipeDto
classes.description: DTO for updating an existing recipe, similar structure to CreateRecipeDto with validation.

classes.name: RecipeDto
classes.description: DTO representing recipe data returned to clients, including metadata like Id, CreatedAt, and UpdatedAt.
